test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **achievements**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Achievement:** something that you have done successfully, especially through hard work or skill. (सफलतापूर्वक संपादित कार्य, विशेषतः परिश्रम और कौशल द्वारा प्राप्‍त उपलब्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **The discovery of DNA was a major scientific ***achievement***. 
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that we prove our self worth by succeeding and by our accomplishments.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is **option 4**.

Correct Paragraph:__ *We believe our value is in direct proportion to the value of our accomplishments. If we cannot accomplish certain results, we tend to feel (1) __low__ about ourselves. Some of us try too hard and become workaholics and over-achievers. With a few genuine feelings of self-worth, we try to create some and prove that we are somebody by our successes and** (2)** __**achievements**__. Because our desire for perfection is so great, we (3) ______ to set unrealistic goals and place unreasonable demands on ourselves. Failing, rather than encouraging us to have realistic aspirations, only leads to a mere punishing round of self-blame and a resolve to drive ourselves harder next time. If we do not finally achieve our goals, we are (4) ______; despite everything we have done, we still feel (5) ______ inside.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Anxiety: **a feeling of fear, dread, and uneasiness. (चिंता)
 
• **Obstacles: **plural of obstacle; something that makes it difficult for you to do something or go somewhere. (बाधा, अड़चन, अवरोध)
 
• **Actions: **plural of action; doing things, often for a particular purpose. (सक्रियता)
